problems: OCR front matter (lines ~297-940) is partly duplicated and its page numbers before col 19 are lost; Monitum (9) and Notitia (11) rest on page headers and the Ordo.
Elenchus '99' (Scorsi Proaemia) and '1159' (Novellae) fall inside other works and were read as 49 and 1149.
Ordo columns for the 62 homilies are visibly garbled in many places; the parts array records them as read (ordo-only) and none was body-confirmed.
Ordo prints 'Festa totius anni 155' where the Elenchus and body give 135.

Editorial pieces present in body/Ordo without an Elenchus line (Testimonia veterum de Theophane col 131; Notitia in Nilum col 1079; Isaac Oratio chapter list) are noted in the neighbouring entries, not made entries.
